title: Zedd to Headline the Official U.S. Open Finals Afterparty
summary: HoneyLuv will also play the Sept. 12 event at New York's Louis Armstrong Stadium.
contentText:
The 2026 U.S. Open Tennis Championships begin in late August and, regardless of who takes home the trophies, will feature a winning afterparty. Dance music all-star Zedd is set to headline the U.S. Open Finals Afterparty on Sept. 12 at New York’s Louis Armstrong Stadium, with mighty house producer HoneyLuv also on the night’s bill.

Admission to this doubleheader requires a separate ticket, with a pair of presales opening on July 9 and a sale for the general public happening on July 10 at 10 a.m. ET.

This is the third year the famous tennis tournament will feature this style of dance afterparty, with l ast year’s show featuring Odesza and Tokimonsta, and year one featuring Galantis. Happening this year on Sept. 12-13, The Afterparty event will also feature expanded grounds access for fans, viewing parties, surprise guests and, as organizers said, “real-time celebrity arrivals” streaming on big screens inside Louis Armstrong Stadium and on the complex’s Fountain Plaza.

This year The Lumineers will also perform a tournament opening show at Louis Armstrong Stadium on Aug. 21.

The U.S. Open takes place Aug. 24 through Sept. 13 at the USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center in Flushing, Queens, and will feature many of the world’s leading tennis players competing in men’s singles and doubles, women’s singles and doubles and mixed doubles. The complex’s main facility, the nearly 24,000-capacity Arthur Ashe Stadium, made history last year when it hosted its first ever electronic music show, a sold-out headlining set by Swedish House Mafia.
